selectionRule: Start at existing example README; recursively include uniquely resolved local links and imports only under examples/spending-alerts and packages/ts/src. Exclude fixtures/tests/oracle paths; do not fetch external imports or resolve package aliases. No task-specific source selection.

limitations: Structural local path audit only; not TypeScript module resolution, link-anchor validation, answer-leak detection or proof that tasks are answerable.
External packages and computed imports need review. No reference causes a file to be added. Files with innocuous names can still contain hidden answers; human material review is required.
Restrictions are screening signals, not an isolation/security boundary. No runnable material bundle or formal freeze is produced.
